data.raw_text:
Why will there be TWO rallies at EDSA on February 25?

This week marks the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution - a historic moment that reminds us of the power of collective action against tyranny, corruption, and abuse. Ideally, this would have been marked by a single, unified gathering.

Efforts were made to achieve that unity. In fact, various groups came together under the EDSA40 Committee in response to the call of Caritas President Bp. Gerardo Alminaza for a broad, united commemoration. However, the Trillion Peso March Movement (TPMM) declined to support the proposal for a joint rally and opted out of the EDSA40 group.

Among those in the EDSA40 group are the Kilusang Bayan Kontra Kurakot, Artikulo XI, Bunyog, Movement Against Tyranny, Duterte Panagutin Network and more than 100 other organizations and 300 leaders and individuals. A copy of their unity statement can be found here - https://t.co/FOuKx8Wx79 

The concerns of some in TPMM, namely SIKLAB, Tindig Pilipinas and Akbayan, centered on the belief - despite repeated clarifications - that some groups in the EDSA40 Committee are allegedly pushing for unconstitutional and violent means, such as a military junta or revolutionary government. There were also some within TPMM opposing calls for the resignation, impeachment, or accountability of President Marcos, arguing that these would only benefit Vice President Sara Duterte.

Despite efforts to correct these misconceptions and outright disinformation, the position against a unified rally prevailed within TPMM.

As a result, two separate rallies will take place. 

The EDSA40 Committee rally will take place at 1:00–4:00 PM at Ortigas Ave. corner EDSA, near the EDSA Shrine. It will carry the theme: “Tuloy ang Laban sa Korapsyon at Kahirapan! Lahat ng Sangkot, Dapat Managot!”

It will feature voices from the basic sectors, casts a critical eye on all post-EDSA regimes, and won’t hesitate to demand accountability all the way to the top, meaning Pres. Marcos himself and his erstwhile UniTeam Vice Pres. Sara Duterte. 

Sa huli, ang diwa ng EDSA ay nasa pagkilos ng mamamayan. Everyone is invited to join either rallies. But I will be at the EDSA40 rally because I believe that lahat ng sangkot, dapat managot hanggang sa tuktok.

Tuloy ang laban! Kitakits sa EDSA cor. Ortigas sa Feb. 25!
